contradiction_resolution: No claim-level contradiction: contradicts_claim_ids is empty, and the statement does not oppose CONJ-0001, THM-0001–THM-0007, OBS-0001, or RED-0001. It is compatible with THM-0005 (c(6)=5, so n=6 lies outside published CKgP range and stratification/Gysin assembly is a natural residual method) and with sibling FND-0020/FND-0036 forgetful-Leray bookkeeping (the base local-system contribution still requires stratified assembly on M_{6,5}). Independent primary checks. (1) Hyperelliptic codimension: dim M_g=3g-3 and dim H_g=2g-1 (Pries arXiv math/0601596 §2.1), so codim(H_6⊂M_6)=(3·6-3)-(2·6-1)=4 as claimed; the same codimension persists for the hyperelliptic locus in M_{6,5}. Standard Thom–Gysin/localization for a smooth closed immersion of pure codimension c supplies the contribution H^{p-2c}(stratum)(-c)≅H^{p-8}(H_6)(−4) with Tate twist Q(−4), so the stated shift/twist bookkeeping is correct; differentials of the localization spectral sequence must still be controlled. (2) Restriction to the open stratum is neither injective nor surjective in general by the localization long exact sequence (support cohomology of the closed strata intervenes), so evaluating only the open gonality stratum cannot bound pure-weight pieces of H^*(total; L). (3) Gonality range for g=6: Brill–Noether gives generic gonality ⌊(g+3)/2⌋=4, so smooth genus-6 curves realize only gonality values 2,3,4 (hyperelliptic, trigonal, tetragonal); there is no residual gonality-5 stratum. SRC-0004/Canning–Larson (arXiv 2208.02357v2 §§8–10) explicitly stratify by gonality M^k_{g,n} for k=2,3,4 and, in genus 6, identify a further Brill–Noether-special plane-quintic locus PQ⊂M_6 inside the tetragonal (gonality-4) open: smooth plane quintics have genus 6 and gonality 4 (projection from a point) while carrying a g^2_5 with ρ(6,2,5)=−3<0. Residual BN specializations are therefore refinements inside a single gonality stratum, not separate gonality strata—matching the mislabelling clause. Distinct from FND-0031/FND-0034 (Deligne weight spectral sequence of the Deligne–Mumford boundary, depth-one Gysin from codimension-one strata) and from FND-0020 (mixed weights of R^1π_*Q): do not merge. ATT-0011 shift/twist provenance was not re-audited (artifact absent from the read-only workspace) and is not required for the mathematical promotion of the obstruction. Promote from candidate to corroborated; evidence_class upgraded from legacy_artifact to primary_source. Merge target: none.
